DRAFT: prepared for founder review

We're developing a digital template pack (Notion and Google Sheets) designed to help freelance graphic designers in Egypt and the MENA region track client projects, invoices sent, and revision rounds. The pack is intended for designers who work with multiple clients at once and need an efficient way to manage their workflow. We're looking for feedback on this idea. Please share your thoughts or suggestions.
